name: Carolina Clock 'Stravaganza 2025

venue.name: 5th & Washington Event Center
venue.address: 103 C South 5th Street Mebane, North Carolina

information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event.** **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CarolinaClockStravaganza2025#62048-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. A t-shirt is included with registration. Please include your t-shirt size in the comment on your registration. **Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring ONE guest with them to the competition.** Yes, parents and siblings count as guests.
